Here are the clarifying questions I'd want answered before scoping this build. I've organized them by priority — the first is the most critical since the word "fabric" changes everything about the data model, 3D requirements, and target users.

---

## 🔍 Clarifying Questions: B2B 3D Fabric Construction Platform

### 1. 🧵 What does "fabric" mean here? *(Most critical — determines the entire domain model)*

| Option | Domain | What users construct |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | Textile / Garment | Weave structures, yarn paths, colorways, repeat patterns |
| **B** | Tensile / Architectural | Membrane panels, shade structures, tensile roofs, PVC/ETFE geometry |
| **C** | Geotextile / Civil | Erosion-control layouts, drainage fabrics, installation plans on site maps |
| **D** | Technical / Industrial | Composite layups, filtration media, ballistics/medical specialty fabrics |

---

### 2. 🖱️ What can users actually *do* in the 3D editor?

- [ ] **Draw / reshape geometry** — CAD-like surface or panel editing (precision, snap, constraints)
- [ ] **Paint / apply patterns** — Tile colorways or textures onto 3D surfaces in real time
- [ ] **Simulate physics** — Drape, tension test, or wrinkle simulation
- [ ] **Annotate / measure** — Cut lines, seam allowances, anchor points, dimensions
- [ ] **View only** — 3D is presentation; editing happens in 2D panels/forms

> *Which of these are Day 1 vs. later? Physics simulation is the most expensive engineering bet.*

---

### 3. 👥 Who buys this, and how do teams share work?

- **A) Single-company internal** — One org, multiple departments (design, engineering, sales) with role-based access
- **B) Agency + client review** — Fabricator creates; client gets a read-only/approval link
- **C) Multi-tenant SaaS** — Each company gets an isolated workspace; optional shared template marketplace
- **D) Distributor hierarchy** — A brand licenses down to regional dealers, each managing sub-accounts

> *Also: Do clients outside the buyer org ever need to log in, comment, or e-sign approvals?*

---

### 4. 📐 What does a "project" contain as structured data?

What are the core entities?
- Products / SKUs?
- Projects / jobs / orders?
- Material specs (weight, tensile strength, color codes)?
- Cut files or patterns?
- Customer/site information?

> *The 3D viewer needs a backing data model — understanding what objects live in the DB shapes the whole API.*

---

### 5. 🔗 What are the integration requirements?

- ERP / MES systems (SAP, Dynamics, custom)?
- CAD formats to import/export (DXF, STEP, OBJ, SVG pattern files)?
- Product catalog or pricing engine?
- E-signature or quoting/CPQ workflows?

---

### 6. 💻 Tech stack preferences or constraints?

**3D layer:**
- Three.js / React Three Fiber (best SaaS fit, large ecosystem)
- Babylon.js (stronger PBR materials + WebGPU, better for precision industrial)
- CAD-server approach: STEP/DXF processed server-side, streamed to browser
- No preference — pick what fits best

**Backend:**
- Does this extend your existing AOS/swarm codebase or start fresh?
- Any preference on DB (Postgres, TimescaleDB), auth provider (Clerk, Auth0), or cloud target?

---

### 7. 💰 Business model & scale targets

- Per-seat subscription, usage-based, or project-based billing?
- Expected number of tenants at launch vs. 12-month target?
- Does each tenant have a storage quota (large 3D files can be GBs)?
- Any compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO)?

---

### 8. 🧭 What does "done" look like for v1?

Which of these defines your MVP?
- [ ] Users can **upload** a geometry and **view** it in 3D
- [ ] Users can **draw/edit** panel geometry in-browser
- [ ] Users can **export** a cut file / production-ready output
- [ ] A sales team can **generate a quote** from a 3D design
- [ ] Multiple users can **collaborate** on the same design in real time

---

**The two biggest bets that change scope 10x:**
1. **Physics simulation** — adds months; needs a dedicated engine (Rapier, Cannon, or Blender headless)
2. **Real-time multiplayer 3D editing** — needs CRDTs/WebSockets and operational transforms on top of the 3D scene graph

Everything else (auth, multi-tenancy, file storage, billing, RBAC) is well-trodden ground your swarm agents handle well. The answers to questions **1, 2, and 4** are the unlock — they determine what *kind* of 3D problem this is.

## 1. Architecture Overview

```
│  Browser (Next.js 14 App Router + React Three Fiber)            │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐   │
│  │ App Shell    │  │ 3D Editor Canvas│  │ Collab Presence  │   │
│  │ (Clerk auth) │  │ (R3F + drei)    │  │ (WS client)      │   │
│  └──────┬───────┘  └────────┬────────┘  └────────┬─────────┘   │
└─────────┼───────────────────┼────────────────────┼─────────────┘
          │ HTTPS REST        │ HTTPS REST          │ WSS
          ▼                   ▼                     ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  API Layer: Next.js Route Handlers (app/api/**)                 │
│  + Collab WebSocket Server (standalone Node ws process)         │
│  ┌────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Auth MW    │  │ Tenant Guard │  │ Presigned S3 endpoint  │  │
│  │ (Clerk SDK)│  │ (RLS check)  │  │ (asset upload/fetch)   │  │
│  └────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
          ┌───────────────┼──────────────────────┐
          ▼               ▼                      ▼
   ┌─────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────────────┐
   │ PostgreSQL  │ │ S3-compat    │  │ BullMQ + Redis       │
   │ (Supabase)  │ │ (CF R2/AWS)  │  │ (export job queue)   │
   └─────────────┘ └──────────────┘  └──────────┬───────────┘
                                                  ▼
                                       ┌──────────────────────┐
                                       │ Export Worker (Node) │
                                       │ dxf-writer / SVG gen │
                                       └──────────────────────┘
```

**Multi-tenancy**: every table has `tenant_id`. API sets `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = $1` before each query; Postgres RLS enforces isolation automatically.

**3D Asset pipeline**: Upload OBJ/GLTF → presigned S3 PUT → S3 event → BullMQ job → convert OBJ→GLTF, generate LOD variants, extract UV metadata → status `ready` → browser loads via `useGLTF(preSignedUrl)`.

**RBAC**:

| Role | Clerk Mapping | Permissions |
|---|---|---|
| `tenant_admin` | `org:admin` | Full CRUD, billing, members |
| `designer` | `org:member` + metadata | Create/edit designs, run exports |
| `viewer` | `org:member` + metadata | Read-only across tenant |
| `client_reviewer` | No Clerk org | Signed JWT share link, single design |

```sql
CREATE TABLE projects (

  tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

ALTER TABLE projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY projects_tenant_isolation ON projects
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- ASSETS (must exist before fabric_designs)
CREATE TABLE assets (
  id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name             TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (asset_type IN (

                     'colorway_texture','export_output','lod_mesh')),
  mime_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
  s3_key           TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  s3_bucket        TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size_bytes  BIGINT,
  status           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                   CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','ready','error')),
  processing_error TEXT,
  metadata         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  -- {vertex_count, face_count, uv_bounds, lod_keys:[], original_format}
  uploaded_by      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE assets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY assets_tenant_isolation ON assets
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- FABRIC DESIGNS
CREATE TABLE fabric_designs (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name               TEXT NOT NULL,
  description        TEXT,
  version            INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  status             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
                     CHECK (status IN ('draft','in_review','approved','archived')),
  thumbnail_url      TEXT,
  base_mesh_asset_id UUID REFERENCES assets(id),
  metadata           JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  locked_by          UUID REFERENCES users(id),  -- optimistic write lock
  locked_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_by         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE fabric_designs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY fabric_designs_tenant_isolation ON fabric_designs
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- WEAVE STRUCTURES (library)
CREATE TABLE weave_structures (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id      UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- NULL = system
  name           TEXT NOT NULL,
  weave_type     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (weave_type IN (
                   'plain','twill','satin','basket','leno','jacquard','dobby','custom')),
  shaft_count    INT,
  treadle_count  INT,
  threading      JSONB,       -- [[shaft_indices per end], ...]
  tieup          JSONB,       -- [[bool shaft×treadle matrix]]
  treadling      JSONB,       -- [[treadle_indices per pick], ...]
  drawdown_cache JSONB,       -- precomputed binary grid
  is_system      BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_by     UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE weave_structures ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY weave_structures_access ON weave_structures
  USING (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- YARN SPECS
CREATE TABLE yarn_specs (
  id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id           UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- NULL = system
  name                TEXT NOT NULL,
  fiber_content       JSONB NOT NULL,  -- [{fiber:'cotton',pct:80},{fiber:'polyester',pct:20}]
  yarn_count          NUMERIC(8,3),    -- metric count (Nm)
  twist_per_meter     INT,
  twist_direction     TEXT CHECK (twist_direction IN ('S','Z')),
  ply                 INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  tensile_strength_cn NUMERIC(10,2),
  elongation_pct      NUMERIC(5,2),
  color_hex           TEXT,
  supplier            TEXT,
  supplier_ref        TEXT,
  is_system           BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_by          UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE yarn_specs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY yarn_specs_access ON yarn_specs
  USING (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- COLORWAYS
CREATE TABLE colorways (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  design_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabric_designs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name               TEXT NOT NULL,
  warp_yarn_id       UUID REFERENCES yarn_specs(id),
  weft_yarn_id       UUID REFERENCES yarn_specs(id),
  warp_color_hex     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FFFFFF',
  weft_color_hex     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#000000',
  weave_structure_id UUID REFERENCES weave_structures(id),
  repeat_width_mm    NUMERIC(8,3),
  repeat_height_mm   NUMERIC(8,3),
  texture_asset_id   UUID REFERENCES assets(id),  -- baked PNG/KTX2
  procedural_params  JSONB,  -- {scale, rotation, offset} for shader
  is_default         BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_by         UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE colorways ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY colorways_tenant_isolation ON colorways
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- FABRIC PANELS
CREATE TABLE fabric_panels (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  design_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabric_designs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name               TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'Front Bodice', 'Left Sleeve'
  sort_order         INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  geometry           JSONB NOT NULL,
  -- {type:'Polygon'|'ParametricMesh', vertices:[[x,y],...], uvs:[[u,v],...]}
  transform          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT
                     '{"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0],"scale":[1,1,1]}'::jsonb,
  seam_allowance_mm  NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  grain_line_angle   NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_colorway_id UUID REFERENCES colorways(id),
  annotations        JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  metadata           JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE fabric_panels ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY fabric_panels_tenant_isolation ON fabric_panels
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- COMMENTS / ANNOTATIONS
CREATE TABLE comments (
  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  design_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabric_designs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  panel_id    UUID REFERENCES fabric_panels(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  author_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  body        TEXT NOT NULL,
  anchor      JSONB,  -- {type:'point'|'region', coords:[x,y,z]}
  resolved    BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  resolved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  parent_id   UUID REFERENCES comments(id),
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE comments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY comments_tenant_isolation ON comments
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- EXPORT JOBS
CREATE TABLE export_jobs (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  design_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabric_designs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  requested_by    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  format          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('dxf','svg','pdf')),
  panel_ids       UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  options         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  -- {seam_allowance:true, grain_lines:true, notches:true, scale:1.0}
  status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
                  CHECK (status IN ('queued','processing','done','failed')),
  output_asset_id UUID REFERENCES assets(id),
  error_message   TEXT,
  started_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
  completed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE export_jobs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY export_jobs_tenant_isolation ON export_jobs
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid);

-- SHARE LINKS
CREATE TABLE share_links (
  id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  tenant_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  design_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabric_designs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'base64url'),
  created_by   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  expires_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  access_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  revoked      BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- AUDIT LOG (SOC 2)
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
  id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id  UUID NOT NULL,
  user_id    UUID,
  action     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'design.created', 'export.requested'
  resource   TEXT,           -- 'fabric_designs:uuid'
  metadata   JSONB,
  ip_address INET,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX audit_logs_tenant_ts ON audit_logs(tenant_id, created_at DESC);
```

### Weave Shader (procedural, no texture needed for simple weaves)

```glsl
// weave.frag.glsl
uniform sampler2D weaveTexture;
uniform vec2 repeatScale;  // (panelWidth_mm / repeat_mm)
varying vec2 vUv;

void main() {
  vec2 tiledUv = fract(vUv * repeatScale);
  gl_FragColor = texture2D(weaveTexture, tiledUv);
}
```

For >32×32 drawdowns (jacquard): bake to `.ktx2` PNG in WebWorker, upload to S3, load via `KTX2Loader`.

## 7. Key Technical Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 3D library | React Three Fiber | Native React component model; panels as `<PanelMesh>` components = targeted re-renders not full scene rebuilds; `drei` provides TransformControls, Html overlays, useGLTF caching; large fashion-tech ecosystem (CLO3D, Browzwear export GLTF) |
| Canonical format | GLTF 2.0 | One format understood by Blender, Three.js, AR; OBJ accepted at upload but converted immediately; `EXT_meshopt_compression` cuts sizes 2–5× |
| Weave gen | Procedural GLSL + baked fallback | Shader for simple weaves (plain/twill/satin): resolution-independent, respects physical repeat via UV scaling, zero texture memory, 60fps. Bake to `.ktx2` only for jacquard with >32×32 drawdown grid |
| DXF export | `dxf-writer` (Node.js) | Avoids Python subprocess in worker Docker image; covers all v1 entities (LWPOLYLINE, LINE, CIRCLE); `AC1015` header for CNC compat. Migrate to `ezdxf` sidecar only if complex DXF features needed |
| Real-time collab | Optimistic locking + WS broadcast | CRDTs (Yjs) add 3-4 weeks; v1 primary case is one-designer-edits, others watch. Lock at structural edit level; colorways/annotations are last-write-wins. Migration path: replace `panel_change` WS + DB write with `Y.Doc` update |

## 8. Risk Register

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **3D performance on complex garments** | 60fps drop on mid-range laptops | Enforce LOD cap at 50k vertices; `frameloop="demand"`; "Performance mode" toggle disables shadows + post-processing |
| **DXF accuracy for CNC cutting** | Expensive fabric waste from bad coordinates | All geometry in mm internally, never pixels; test suite exports known shapes and asserts vertex coords to 3dp; visual flat-pattern preview before download; beta with one real CNC machine |
| **RLS misconfiguration leaks tenant data** | Catastrophic for B2B | CI integration test: two tenants, assert cross-tenant queries return 0 rows; CI schema check every table has RLS enabled; Postgres trigger warns if `app.current_tenant_id` not set |
| **S3 storage cost runaway** | Unchecked GB growth per tenant | Enforce storage limit before presigning upload URL; S3 lifecycle rule deletes `status='error'` objects after 7 days; Glacier archive for designs marked `archived` after 90 days |
| **WS server single point of failure** | All collaborators disconnected | PM2 auto-restart (<2s); client exponential backoff reconnect to 30s; presence is ephemeral (no DB state to corrupt); v2: migrate to Ably/Liveblocks or Redis pub/sub with sticky LB |

**Multi-tenancy**: every table has `tenant_id`. API sets `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = $1` before each query; Postgres RLS enforces isolation automatically.

**3D Asset pipeline**: Upload OBJ/GLTF → presigned S3 PUT → S3 event → BullMQ job → convert OBJ→GLTF, generate LOD variants, extract UV metadata → status `ready` → browser loads via `useGLTF(preSignedUrl)`.

**RBAC**:

| Role | Clerk Mapping | Permissions |
|---|---|---|
| `tenant_admin` | `org:admin` | Full CRUD, billing, members |
| `designer` | `org:member` + metadata | Create/edit designs, run exports |
| `viewer` | `org:member` + metadata | Read-only across tenant |
| `client_reviewer` | No Clerk org | Signed JWT share link, single design |

### Weave Shader (procedural, no texture needed for simple weaves)

```glsl
// weave.frag.glsl
uniform sampler2D weaveTexture;
uniform vec2 repeatScale;  // (panelWidth_mm / repeat_mm)
varying vec2 vUv;

void main() {
  vec2 tiledUv = fract(vUv * repeatScale);
  gl_FragColor = texture2D(weaveTexture, tiledUv);
}
```

For >32×32 drawdowns (jacquard): bake to `.ktx2` PNG in WebWorker, upload to S3, load via `KTX2Loader`.

## 7. Key Technical Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 3D library | React Three Fiber | Native React component model; panels as `<PanelMesh>` components = targeted re-renders not full scene rebuilds; `drei` provides TransformControls, Html overlays, useGLTF caching; large fashion-tech ecosystem (CLO3D, Browzwear export GLTF) |
| Canonical format | GLTF 2.0 | One format understood by Blender, Three.js, AR; OBJ accepted at upload but converted immediately; `EXT_meshopt_compression` cuts sizes 2–5× |
| Weave gen | Procedural GLSL + baked fallback | Shader for simple weaves (plain/twill/satin): resolution-independent, respects physical repeat via UV scaling, zero texture memory, 60fps. Bake to `.ktx2` only for jacquard with >32×32 drawdown grid |
| DXF export | `dxf-writer` (Node.js) | Avoids Python subprocess in worker Docker image; covers all v1 entities (LWPOLYLINE, LINE, CIRCLE); `AC1015` header for CNC compat. Migrate to `ezdxf` sidecar only if complex DXF features needed |
| Real-time collab | Optimistic locking + WS broadcast | CRDTs (Yjs) add 3-4 weeks; v1 primary case is one-designer-edits, others watch. Lock at structural edit level; colorways/annotations are last-write-wins. Migration path: replace `panel_change` WS + DB write with `Y.Doc` update |

## 8. Risk Register

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **3D performance on complex garments** | 60fps drop on mid-range laptops | Enforce LOD cap at 50k vertices; `frameloop="demand"`; "Performance mode" toggle disables shadows + post-processing |
| **DXF accuracy for CNC cutting** | Expensive fabric waste from bad coordinates | All geometry in mm internally, never pixels; test suite exports known shapes and asserts vertex coords to 3dp; visual flat-pattern preview before download; beta with one real CNC machine |
| **RLS misconfiguration leaks tenant data** | Catastrophic for B2B | CI integration test: two tenants, assert cross-tenant queries return 0 rows; CI schema check every table has RLS enabled; Postgres trigger warns if `app.current_tenant_id` not set |
| **S3 storage cost runaway** | Unchecked GB growth per tenant | Enforce storage limit before presigning upload URL; S3 lifecycle rule deletes `status='error'` objects after 7 days; Glacier archive for designs marked `archived` after 90 days |
| **WS server single point of failure** | All collaborators disconnected | PM2 auto-restart (<2s); client exponential backoff reconnect to 30s; presence is ephemeral (no DB state to corrupt); v2: migrate to Ably/Liveblocks or Redis pub/sub with sticky LB |
